data.one_liner: Automatically export Dart classes and enums using annotations and build_runner.
data.what_it_does: Auto Exporter is a code generation tool that automatically creates export directives for Dart classes and enums within a project or sub-packages. It allows developers to control what gets exported using annotations like @AutoExport and @IgnoreExport, and configures via build.yaml.
use_when: You want to automate the maintenance of export statements in large Dart or Flutter packages.
You need explicit control over what gets exported using annotations.
avoid_when: Your project does not use code generation or build_runner.
You prefer manually managing export files.
strengths: Sorts and formats export lists consistently across different devices and environments.
Supports sub-package exporting and configurable default export behaviors.
weaknesses: Requires build_runner to generate files, adding a build step to development.
Depends on specific versions of the analyzer and build packages.
data.setup_notes: Add auto_exporter_annotation to dependencies, auto_exporter and build_runner to dev_dependencies, and configure build.yaml at the root of the project.
data.minimal_example:
targets:
  $default:
    builders:
      auto_exporter:
        options:
          default_export_all: true
          project_name: <your plugin name>
